# Learn Biology

> > Interactive biology education platform covering AP Biology, biochemistry, evolution, ecology, and molecular biology with tutorials, student learning guides, and engaging multimedia content.

Learn Biology provides comprehensive biology education resources for high school and AP Biology students, featuring interactive tutorials on topics ranging from basic chemistry and biochemistry to evolution, ecology, and molecular biology. The platform integrates with Google Classroom and offers innovative teaching approaches including karaoke music videos for complex topics like protein synthesis.

## Key Topics

- AP Biology
- Biochemistry
- DNA and RNA
- Evolution
- Ecology and Ecosystems
- Photosynthesis
- Protein Synthesis
- Covalent Bonds
- Phylogenetic Trees
- Food Webs and Trophic Levels
- Carbon and Nitrogen Cycles
- Homologous and Vestigial Structures
- Galapagos Finches
- ATP (Adenosine Triphosphate)
- Scientific Method and Controlled Experiments

## Biochemistry and Molecular Biology

- [Biochemistry 1: Monomers and Polymers; The Four Families of Biological Molecules (Interactive Tutorial)](https://learn-biology.com/ap-biology/module-6-menu-biochemistry/biochemistry-1-monomers-and-polymers-the-four-families-of-biological-molecules-ap-interactive-tutorial): Interactive tutorial on monomers, polymers, and biomolecule families
- [Biochemistry 5: Nucleic Acids Overview](https://learn-biology.com/ap-biology/module-6-menu-biochemistry/biochemistry-5-nucleic-acids-overview): Overview of DNA and RNA nucleic acids in molecular biology
- [Protein Synthesis Karaoke (Music Video Page)](https://learn-biology.com/karaoke-biology/protein-synthesis-karaoke-music-video-page): Educational music video on protein synthesis and translation process

## Chemistry Fundamentals

- [The Structure of Water and Hydrogen Bonding (including Acids and Bases): Student Learning Guide](https://learn-biology.com/ap-biology/chemistry-of-water-tutorials/the-chemistry-and-properties-of-water-student-learning-guide): Student guide covering water structure, hydrogen bonding, and acids/bases
- [Basic Chemistry Tutorial 5: Covalent Bonds](https://learn-biology.com/basic-chemistry-tutorial-5-covalent-bonds): Tutorial on covalent bonds and electron sharing in molecules
- [Basic Chemistry Conclusion and Final Quiz](https://learn-biology.com/basic-chemistry-conclusion-and-final-quiz): Final assessment quiz on basic chemistry topics and chemical bonds

## Evolution and Phylogeny

- [Evidence for Evolution (3): Homologous and Vestigial Structures (HS Level)](https://learn-biology.com/hsbio/evidence-for-evolution-hs-level-main-menu/evidence-for-evolution-3-homologous-and-vestigial-structures-hs-level): High school tutorial on homologous and vestigial structures as evolution evidence
- [Clades and Phylogenetic Trees, Part 1 (HS Level)](https://learn-biology.com/hsbio/clades-and-phylogenetic-trees): High school tutorial on phylogenetic trees and Galapagos finches
- [Origin of Life, Student Learning Guide](https://learn-biology.com/ap-biology/module-22-origin-and-early-evolution-of-life/origin-of-life-student-learning-guide): AP Biology student guide on origin of life and early evolution

## Ecology and Ecosystems

- [Ecosystems](https://learn-biology.com/ap-biology/ecology-tutorials): AP Biology ecology tutorials covering ecosystems, food webs, and cycles

## Cellular Processes

- [The Two Phases of Photosynthesis (HS Tutorial)](https://learn-biology.com/hsbio/photosynthesis-high-school-level-main-menu/the-two-phases-of-photosynthesis-hs-tutorial): High school tutorial on photosynthesis phases and chloroplast structure

## Scientific Method

- [Controlled Experiments](https://learn-biology.com/controlled-experiments): Scientific method tutorial on controlled experiments and hypothesis testing
